text:
Type: round glass coffee table on wheels
Use: holding drinks, books and decor in front of a sofa; living room, family room
Style: modern, contemporary, minimalist
Materials: white tempered glass top and shelf, nickel-plated steel tube frame, wheels
Colors: glossy white, silver
Shape: round glass top and matching lower shelf, thin metal rings around the edges, slim tube legs, two large disc wheels, light and open
Feel: sleek, bright, clean, airy
Goes with: grey or white sofas, chrome and glass accents, pale floors; modern living rooms and small apartments

product.name: STRIND
product.description: Separate shelf for magazines, etc. helps you keep your things organised and the table top clear.
